when winter arrives in kiruna, creators from around the world gather to build icehotel in jukkasjärvi, using the ice from the frozen torne river. a breathtaking and unique hotel that appears in new shapes each year. from the northern lights to the midnight sun - icehotel offers an incredible experience all year round.
Photo cred
Asaf Kliger
From the northern lights to the midnight sun
At ICEHOTEL in Kiruna, we mix adventures in nature with art and tranquility for the soul. We have activities for everyone, whether you want to hike, go dog sledding or experience rafting on the Torne River - and it all takes place in the exquisite, unspoiled nature.
ICEHOTEL offers a unique Arctic holiday in both winter and summer. Here you stay in a hotel made of ice - but you will also experience the vastness and adventures of Northern Sweden. Our coffee is brewed over an open fire, and the food is carefully prepared using local ingredients.
Read our guide to Swedish Lapland and Jukkasjärvi.
The midnight sun shines above Jukkasjärvi for 47 days each summer, learn about the phenomenon.
Karl & Moa
Eat and drink
At ICEHOTEL, every meal is special and an essential part of the experience for our visitors. Here, loud restaurants and fast food are replaced with the opportunity to quietly savour truly delicious, well-prepared dishes.

icehotel winter
Open december - april
The original ICEHOTEL, open every year since 1989. This is the hotel for those who visit us in winter and want to stay in the latest rendition of the original ICEHOTEL, entirely made of ice and snow. In ICEHOTEL Winter, we offer two different room options: Ice rooms and Art Suites. Our ice rooms are our standard room with ice décor. The art suites are individually designed and hand carved by artists from all over the world.

pages.text:
ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL | ICEHOTEL
ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL
Welcome to a world made entirely from ice and snow from the Torne River, 200 km north of the Arctic Circle. For over thirty years, people from near and far have traveled to Kiruna to experience the magic of ICEHOTEL – we create memories that last a lifetime!
Every year when the Torne River turns to ice, we transform its natural material into a hotel and art exhibition. The natural material from the Torne River also creates our ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL.
By becoming an ICEBAR franchisee, you can bring parts of this extraordinary experience to your part of the world!
Asaf Kliger
Asaf Kliger
Asaf Kliger
Asaf Kliger
Asaf Kliger
Asaf Kliger
Karl & Moa
ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL COPENHAGEN
In November 2025 ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL Copenhagen opened its doors - a meeting place on Strøget, created from 50 tonnes of crystal-clear natural ice from the Torne River. Here, guest step into a world of Arctic Magic, where the city's energy meets the Arctic stillness.
The theme "Origin" is designed by Swedish artist duo Christian Strömqvist and Karl-Johan Ekeroth. The design celebrates water as the source of life and the Torne River - the birthplace of ICEHOTEL and the natural material that forms both ICEHOTEL and ICEBAR.
ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL STOCKHOLM
In the early 2000s, ICEHOTEL’s founder Yngve Bergqvist wanted to expand the ICEBAR concept. Together with artists Åke Larsson and Arne Bergh, he aimed to bring ICEBAR to the world, allowing more cities and people to enjoy the frozen experience.
Stockholm was the first to open the doors to ICEBAR by ICEHOTEL in 2002 – the world’s first permanent ice bar! Today, ICEBAR by ICEHOTEL, located right next to Stockholm Central Station, attracts 100,000 visitors annually. With its spectacular design, it has become an iconic meeting spot for both locals and tourists from all corners of the world.
Chilled drinks
At ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL, drinks are served in glasses made of crystal-clear ice from the Torne River. These ice glasses are crafted in Jukkasjärvi and shipped to each ICEBAR in custom-designed refrigerated containers. These exclusive glasses are a big part of the ICEBAR experience – there’s something truly special about enjoying one of our signature drinks from a glass made of ice.
our promise
When you partner with ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL, you become one of our carefully selected collaborators. We work closely with you, with a goal to create a positive and profitable work environment for both you and ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL. Our focus is on long-term success and warm relationships.
Thomas Engström

About the Company | ICEHOTEL
Karl & Moa
about the company
The ICEHOTEL in Jukkasjärvi is both a world-unique hotel and an art exhibition crafted from snow and ice.
Inspired by the Torne River, the first small gallery showcased art made from the river’s frozen waters. Since then, ICEHOTEL has been reborn in a new form each winter - a magical and fleeting creation that melts back into the river as the spring sun warms.
Now, over 30 years since we began, it’s possible to enjoy this magical experience all year round. ICEHOTEL 365, cooled by solar power, maintains a steady minus-five-degree temperature, allowing our guests to marvel at fantastic ice creations even under the midnight sun in summer.
Asaf Kliger
our origin
The iconic ICEHOTEL in Jukkasjärvi in Swedish Lapland draws visitors from around the world - a dream destination for many. Here, bustling streets are swapped for vast mountain views, city lights for untouched rivers, and the ethereal glow of the northern lights. ICEHOTEL, carved from the Torne River’s ice, offers an unparalleled experience of magic you won’t find anywhere else.
We’re passionate about creating moments and experiences that will last a lifetime. Rooted in the philosophy of living close to nature, our activities - from ice art and wilderness adventures to extraordinary culinary experiences - are all designed in harmony with the Arctic environment.
Asaf Kliger
Ice and design
At ICEHOTEL, we work with the highest quality natural ice, harvested directly from the Torne River. Since the 1990s, through our vast network of artists and designers, we have crafted unique ice experiences for international brands like Volvo, Chanel, and Nobel.
Asaf Kliger
Welcome to the ICEHOTEL family
We’re more than just a hotel - we’re experience artists and storytellers. Our greatest inspiration comes from the ice of the Torne River, the Arctic nature, and the impermanence that makes each artwork and experience one-of-a-kind. Our colourful family here at ICEHOTEL in Jukkasjärvi shares a passion for everything from wilderness life and cuisine to art and events.
Work with us
Karl & Moa
registered trademark
Our ICEHOTEL brand was first registered in 1996, and ICEHOTEL ® | ICEBAR™ | ICEBAR BY ICEHOTEL™ are protected in over 30 countries.
Our brand is a major asset for our continued inspiration and growth, and we are incredibly proud of our identity.

wikipedia.title: Icehotel (Jukkasjärvi)
wikipedia.extract: The Icehotel is a hotel in northern Sweden, about 17 kilometers from Kiruna. It is rebuilt each year with snow and ice in the village of Jukkasjärvi and is the world's first ice hotel.
